service.description:
Runs a DeviceRequest on the driver of its connection: DeviceConnection.driverEnumId (DcdModbusTCP, DcdOpcUa, DcdMqtt, DcdLogixCIPEIP or DcdEthernetIP, DcdEtherCAT), else the scheme of DeviceRequest.brokerUri or DeviceConnection.transportConfig (modbus-tcp://, opc.tcp://, mqtt://, mqtts://, paho-mqtt5:?brokerUrl=..., logix://, eip://, ethercat://). Set it as DeviceRequest.runServiceName, as moqui.plc4j.Plc4jServices.run#Plc4jRequest was; moqui.device.DeviceServices.run#DeviceRequest calls it.
DrtRead reads the items once and stores the values (DeviceAcquisitionServices.store#Samples); with a pollingInterval it polls: it reads again every pollingInterval milliseconds until a DrtUnsubscribe. MQTT has no read. DrtWrite writes the values of the item Parameters; an MQTT write without items publishes the payload parameter as JSON on DeviceRequest.query. DrtStateChange, DrtCyclic and DrtEvent subscribe (the PLC4X subscription types; DrtSubscribe is the default of the protocol): on OPC UA as monitored items, a DrtCyclic one sampled every pollingInterval; on MQTT as broker subscriptions, with no DrtCyclic. Polled and received values are stored through the sample queue. DrtUnsubscribe stops the subscription or polling of parentRequestName.
The item address is DeviceRequestItem.query, else DeviceRequest.query: a Modbus register, an OPC UA node id, an MQTT topic, a Logix tag, an EtherCAT process data offset. With the property device_gateway_device_id set, a device outside the scope of that gateway is refused (DeviceAcquisitionServices.get#GatewayScope).

parameter.name: payload
parameter.description: The message of an MQTT write without items.

parameter.name: status
parameter.description: completed, partial, active, failed, uncertain or unchanged.

service.description: PLC log events over MQTT: a DrtSubscribe or DrtEvent request whose topic (DeviceRequest.query) carries the log events of the moqui-plc LoggerFacade. An event with a source is stored as a ParameterLog of that Parameter, an event without one as a DeviceLog (DeviceAcquisitionServices.store#LogSamples). The loggerName of each event is the device: the device of the request or one of the members of its DeviceGroups. DrtUnsubscribe stops it. Set as DeviceRequest.runServiceName.
